inventory.visualPurpose: Gowers sign sequence in Duchenne muscular dystrophy
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Illustrated sequence of a boy rising from the floor: hands and knees, buttocks raised, pushing on the leg to stand, standing with lordosis; arrows label calf pseudohypertrophy, lordosis, and thigh atrophy

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: H&E image (A): muscle fibers bracket, pale fibrofatty-replacement patches marked by red arrows

notes: Both source images are original KYP schematic redraws preserving diagnostic patterns without reproducing photographs: the Gowers illustration as a four-stage stick-figure sequence (hands-and-knees → buttocks raised → pushing on leg to stand → standing with lordosis, with calf pseudohypertrophy / lordosis / thigh atrophy labels), and the histology image A as a schematic H&E-pattern field (polygonal fibers with peripheral nuclei, three arrowed pale fibrofatty-replacement patches, the muscle-fibers bracket, and the boxed A).
